audit.scope: Read-only S12 visual-regression and consistency audit covering all 52 reachable inventory routes and 9 sheets/dialogs in light/dark themes at 393x852 and 360x800 viewports; verifying route-visible content, header frames/types, card radii, gaps, button/chip heights, dock position, overlaps, horizontal scroll, images/fonts, layout shift, baseline diff, and file reconciliation.

keyFindings: FloatingNav dock geometry (w=365/332px, h=54.5px, margin=14px, radius=27px) strictly conforms to layout tokens across all 208 route captures and 4 viewports/theme combinations.
All 208 route captures exhibited zero document-level horizontal spill (scrollWidth equals clientWidth at both 393px and 360px viewports).
Zero broken images and zero tofu / unicode replacement glyphs (\uFFFD) detected across all screens.
4 privacy-sensitive routes (library/women-purity, library/women-guidance, tools/women-purity, tools/women-guidance) are gated by session lock (womenUnlocked=false) and marked BLOCKED.
6 sheets/dialogs require device sensors, user credentials, or streaming triggers not available in headless automated audit and are marked BLOCKED.
Offline prayer times error banner Retry button renders at 38px height (below 44px WCAG touch target guideline), flagged as Minor consistency defect.
Baseline commit visual regression comparison marked BLOCKED (no BASELINE_COMMIT supplied).
Screenshot reconciliation verified: exactly 224 files expected, 224 captured on disk, 0 missing, 0 extra.

tests.steps: Inspect FloatingNav container boundingClientRect across viewports 393x852 and 360x800 in light and dark themes.
tests.expected: Floating dock has height=54.5px, horizontal side margins=14px, border-radius=27px, floats 14px above screen bottom with backdrop blur and restrained shadow.
tests.actual: Measured geometry at 393x852: w=365px, h=54.5px, x=14px, bottom=14px, borderRadius=27px. At 360x800: w=332px, h=54.5px, x=14px, bottom=14px, borderRadius=27px. Dock floats identically across ink and paper themes.

tests.steps: Inspect AppHeader, SubHeader, ScreenHeader, SheetHeader, and ReaderHeader across all crawled routes.
tests.expected: AppHeader conforms to HEADER_ROW_HEIGHT=32px (top 2px), SubHeader and SheetHeader conform to 54px height with safeTop alignment, non-sticky on hub routes.
tests.actual: AppHeader rendered with height 32px at top 2px; SubHeader and ScreenHeader rendered with height 54px; SheetHeader rendered with 54px on sheets/dialogs.

tests.steps: Inspect Card, AyahCard, HadithCard, and DailyContentRail containers for borderRadius and drop shadows.
tests.expected: Cards apply cardTokens.borderRadius=14px (or 16-18px for hero/prominent cards), 0.75px border, and theme-aware drop shadow (boxShadow on web).
tests.actual: Sampled cards exhibit 14px standard outer radius (with 16-18px for hero cards); dark mode uses boxShadow 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.60) and light mode uses 0 4px 14px rgba(40,35,24,0.12).

tests.steps: Measure vertical gaps between headers, hero sections, and card rails in TabScreen and DetailScreen containers.
tests.expected: Content gap between major sections conforms to CONTENT_GAP=24px; card list items maintain 12-16px margin/gap with no collision.
tests.actual: TabScreen containers maintain 24px vertical section gap; card rails and list items separate cleanly without negative margin overlaps.

tests.feature: Button & Chip Heights / Touch Target Compliance
tests.steps: Measure height and bounding boxes of buttons (role='button') and chips across all routes against WCAG 2.1 AA 2.5.5/2.5.8 (44px target) and design tokens.
tests.expected: Standard action buttons maintain minHeight >= 44px; filter chips maintain minHeight >= 32px with touch hitSlop.
tests.actual: Primary, outline, and screen tab buttons satisfy minHeight >= 44px; chips satisfy minHeight >= 32px. Finding: The offline banner 'Retry' button renders at 38px height (below 44px WCAG touch target guideline).

tests.steps: Inspect scroll container paddingBottom against TAB_PAD_BOTTOM formula (NAV_HEIGHT + safeBottom + 14 + 32 = 100.5px).
tests.expected: All scrollable lists include bottom padding >= 100.5px so final card/list item scrolls completely clear of the floating dock overlay.
tests.actual: Scroll containers implement TAB_PAD_BOTTOM (100.5px to 120px) padding; final list items and cards are fully viewable above the floating dock.

tests.steps: Check document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= clientWidth across all 208 route captures at 393px and 360px viewports.
tests.expected: Zero unintended horizontal scrollbar or document overflow on mobile viewports; scrollWidth equals clientWidth exactly.
tests.actual: scrollWidth equals clientWidth (393px and 360px) across all 208 captures; 0 horizontal layout spill violations detected.

tests.steps: Inspect computed fontFamily on titles, body, and arabic text; scan DOM text for replacement glyph / tofu character (\uFFFD).
tests.expected: Headings render serif display fonts (Lora/Amiri/Noto); body renders sans-serif (Manrope/Poppins); 0 tofu/replacement characters across all routes.
tests.actual: Typography hierarchy applied consistently; zero replacement characters (\uFFFD) detected across all 208 route captures.

tests.steps: Inspect all img elements for naturalWidth > 0 and complete == true across all captured routes.
tests.expected: All image assets (logos, illustrations, icons) render cleanly with zero broken image placeholders.
tests.actual: 0 broken image elements detected across all 208 route captures; asset icons and vector illustrations load without failure.

tests.steps: Observe layout shift entries during route navigation and tab switches.
tests.expected: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) is minimal (< 0.05) once initial route view settles.
tests.actual: Route transitions mount smoothly into established safe-area frames without jumpy late reflows (CLS < 0.05).

tests.feature: Baseline Commit Visual Pixel Regression Diff
tests.steps: Check for BASELINE_COMMIT environment variable or arguments to perform pixel-by-pixel image diff against historical release commit.
tests.expected: When BASELINE_COMMIT is supplied, pixel diff is computed. If no BASELINE_COMMIT is supplied, audit must mark baseline diff BLOCKED, not pass.
tests.actual: No BASELINE_COMMIT was supplied in execution context. Visual regression pixel diff against baseline commit is marked BLOCKED per audit specification.

evidence_values.reason: BASELINE_COMMIT not supplied: visual pixel diff comparison is blocked
